title: A notification with no `action_url` marks itself read and navigates nowhere from the bell
body:
Found while fixing objectui#5179 (PR #5189). Not fixed there — different root cause, different fix. Filed unassigned for triage.

## What is inconsistent

`InboxNotification` (`packages/app-shell/src/layout/inboxGrouping.ts`) declares `source_object` and `source_id`, and `InboxPopover`'s notification click handler reads both as its pre-ADR-0030 back-compat pointer.

But `mergeInboxRows` in `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts` — the single producer of every row both the bell and Home render — maps neither field:

```ts
return {
  id: String(m.id),
  notification_id: nid,
  receipt_id: rec?.id ?? null,
  type: (m.topic as string) ?? 'notification',
  title: (m.title as string) ?? '',
  body: (m.body_md as string) ?? null,
  action_url: (m.action_url as string) ?? null,
  is_read: rec ? READ_STATES.has(rec.state) : false,
  created_at: m.created_at as string | undefined,
} satisfies InboxNotification;
```

`InboxPopover` is internal (not exported from the package barrel) and `AppHeader` is its only consumer, feeding it straight from `useSharedInboxFeed()`. So that back-compat arm is unreachable in the shipped tree today.

## Why it may still be worth a decision rather than a deletion

The producer leaves `action_url` **undefined** when an emit carries neither a `payload.url` nor a `source` — pinned upstream as *"leaves action_url undefined when there is neither a url nor a source"* (`messaging-service.test.ts`). For such a notification the bell's handler calls `onMarkRead(n.id)` and then returns without navigating: the row is consumed and the popover does not even close.

Home's action centre handles the same case deliberately — it falls back to the full inbox (`/apps/<host>/sys_inbox_message?view=mine`, objectui#4074). The bell has no equivalent. Same click, same data, two behaviours.

So there are two candidate readings, and picking one is a product call rather than a mechanical fix:

1. the fields are genuinely retired ⇒ drop the dead arm from `InboxPopover` and give the bell Home's fallback, so a linkless notification still opens something;
2. the fields are meant to be live ⇒ map them in `mergeInboxRows` (the underlying `sys_inbox_message` row would need to carry them — worth confirming against the object definition, which today declares `action_url` but no source columns).

Either way the current state — a declared input shape no producer fills, read by a handler that silently does nothing — is a trap for the next reader.

## Notes

- Severity is deliberately not judged here; this is an observation, not a measured user-facing defect. Nothing in the shipped tree reaches the dead arm.
- objectui#5179 / PR #5189 preserved the arm as-is (routed through the shared target resolver, so it no longer builds a bare `/objects/{object}/{id}`) rather than deciding this question inside a bug fix.
